78989.subject: Weekly Recap: $247 To $1.90 In Three Hours
78989.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

LAPTOP opened on Base at noon UTC Wednesday, closed its first five minutes at $247.55, and traded at $1.90 three hours later. **Hunter Biden**'s memecoin still finished the day near **TRUMP**'s fully diluted valuation, with the larger market capitalization of the two.

The 42 biggest tokenized equities turned over $1.01 billion across the Labor Day weekend with U.S. stock markets shut, $572.8 million of it on **Robinhood Chain**. **Pump.fun** then opened token launches to 93 quote assets, among them tokenized **Nvidia**, **Tesla** and the S&P 500. Robinhood Chain's own gas revenue fell to $943,728 on Thursday from $5.44 million eight days earlier, with transaction counts flat.

**Senate Republicans** posted revised **CLARITY Act** text on Sept. 10 that adds CFTC registration and Bank Secrecy Act obligations for trading protocols that are not decentralized. Cloture ripens Tuesday, sixty votes carry it, and the seven Senate Democrats who negotiated the bill for a year have not withdrawn the opposition statement they issued in July.

**Nasdaq** put $100 million into Kraken's parent at a $21 billion valuation and sold it surveillance technology in the same deal. **Circle** agreed to buy Singapore's **Tazapay** for $400 million in stock. **Block** applied for a national bank charter, and **U.S. Bank** issued its own dollar token on Stellar and moved money between two of its arms with it.

The **Liquid** attacker sent 3,400 BTC back to the federation wallet on Monday and kept 598.5. **Blockstream** said on Friday it will not pay to recover the rest.

Enjoy!

# Top Stories This Week

## Hunter Biden's LAPTOP Opened At $247 And Traded At $1.90 Three Hours Later

Hunter Biden confirmed on Sept. 7 that [the token would deploy on Coinbase's Base network two days later](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-confirms-laptop-memecoin-launch-sept-9), with a fifth of a one billion supply set aside for airdrops that include wallets that lost money on TRUMP, according to The Wall Street Journal. At least 14 copycat LAPTOP tokens appeared on four other networks within an hour of that report and traded $6.9 million between them. The real one opened at 12:00 UTC Wednesday, closed its first five minutes at $247.55 and [changed hands at $1.90 three hours later](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-laptop-falls-99-percent-three-hours-trump-valuation). Both tokens carry a one billion supply, which left LAPTOP and TRUMP within reach of the same $2 billion fully diluted valuation, and LAPTOP's market capitalization the larger of the two. Lookonchain traced a 2.5 million-token team allocation to a [Wintermute-tagged wallet credited with $2.08 million of LAPTOP sales](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/report-links-2-08m-in-laptop-sales-to-wintermute-tagged-wallet); one trader reported nearly empty launch pools and a 98% drop in the opening minutes.

78977.subject: Automatická správa: Notifikácia o úhrade diaľničnej známky
78977.body:
Notifikácia o úhrade diaľničnej známky pre vozidlo s evidenčným číslom vozidla LE066BI 
  
  
 Vážený Užívateľ, 
  
 Správca výberu úhrady diaľničnej známky za užívanie vymedzených úsekov diaľnic v Slovenskej republike, Vám prostredníctvom tejto automaticky vygenerovanej e-mailovej správy na základe Vami realizovanej úhrady diaľničnej známky, evidovanej v rámci evidencie úhrad diaľničných známok k vozidlu/prípojnému vozidlu s evidenčným číslom vozidla LE066BI a krajinou registrácie Slovensko, zasiela doklad „Potvrdenie o úhrade diaľničnej známky, zjednodušená faktúra".
